verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's homepage says the platform "moves cases between agents and your team" and helps "disposition alerts more intelligently" with customizable automation. That implies first-party agents work on alerts and cases, but it is marketing copy only. Nothing documents an agent investigating transaction alerts or drafting review notes. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product AI agent's alert-investigation workflow, evidence that it generates review notes or narratives, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
